scripts.install:projects: npm --prefix frontend ci --ignore-scripts && npm --prefix backend ci --ignore-scripts
scripts.dev: concurrently --names frontend-ssr,backend --prefix "[{name}]" --prefix-colors cyan,green "npm --prefix frontend run dev:ssr" "npm --prefix backend run dev"
scripts.build:production: npm run build:frontend && npm run check:backend
scripts.check: npm run check:frontend && npm run check:backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend
scripts.lint:fix: npm --prefix frontend run lint -- --fix && npm --prefix backend run lint:fix
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
scripts.audit:production: npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm --prefix frontend audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm --prefix backend audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high
scripts.validate:release: npm run lint && npm run check && npm test && npm run e2e && npm run e2e:smoke:cross-browser && npm run audit:production && npm run build:production && npm run assert:production && npm run smoke:production
